notes.title: Update Version 1.52
notes.content:
-Fixed some vessels not having correct equipments.
-Fixed some dialogs and messages text size.  
-Fixed bug on Seal ability.
-Fixed some typo.
-Fixed a bug where the free Remnant buff still consumed 30% of Essence.
-Fixed Blink Strikes consumes stack from Echo Dagger.
-Fixed bug on Second Wind passive.
-Fixed bug on Dark Nova Magic.

notes.title: Update Version 1.5
notes.content:
Version 1.5

-Added support for the following languages: Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish (Spain), and Russian.
-Fixed a bug where equipment wouldn't drop in the Reward Room.
-Fixed a bug with traps in certain dungeons.
-Added custom font support.
-Increased the size of some windows.
-Increased damage scaling on certain abilities.

notes.title: Update Version 1.4
notes.content:
Version 1.4

-Added new boss.
-Fixed dual attack bug involving Klahan and Alicia.
-Renamed Oceanus Temple to Pontus Temple.
-Now all treasures and some objects have zero collision after interaction is completed.
-Fixed some grammar issues.
-Reduced Barrier gain from the Vampiric Talisman from 50% to 20%.
-Reduced EXP gains from certain monsters.
-Increased maximum level growth for some bosses.

notes.title: Update Version 1.3
notes.content:
Version 1.3
-Fixed Paladin of Light achievement.
-Fixed missing enemies in Labyrinth Forest.
-Fixed Enrik's ultimate skill cooldown.
-Fixed some monsters in Obsidian Ruin.
-Fixed Ra's Ankh.

notes.title: Update Version 1.2
notes.content:
Version 1.2
-Fixed a weather bug during fights with Eldritch.
-Added more paths and reduced speed in a certain minigame.
-Slightly reduced Gaia's HP, M.DEF, and P.DEF.
-Fixed some grammar issues.
